minutes.headline: Committee backed a phased plan (Ritter and new town hall first), and voted to put an update article on the special town meeting warrant.
minutes.summary: The Municipal Building Design Committee met with new facilities director Chris Ruth. They discussed ARPA-funded computer and CAD needs, a drafting of RFP language, and a phased plan: TCP roof work and transition use, then Ritter and a new town hall, then town hall renovation, then a phase three tied to Turkey Hill or TCP. They agreed to seek a joint meeting with the school committee and voted by roll call to propose an update-only article for the November special town meeting.

public_comment.topic: A speaker noted that 21 Main Street is on the market, has more land than the town hall, and shares a property line with the town hall ADA ramp.

votes.motion: Propose an article for the special town meeting to provide the public with an update.

budget_items.what_was_said: An ARPA request was submitted and the select board provided it, to cover immediate spending needs such as a computer and architectural support.
A desktop gives much more power for less money than a laptop; the request would go through the town manager and facilities director.
Chris suggested Bluebeam markups as a much cheaper alternative to CAD licenses, though the committee said new drawings are needed.
Best-guess estimated price per square foot including hard and soft cost was cited.
Metal roofing cost per square foot was cited, with TPO over the slopes suggested as a cheaper option.
The frozen mixing valve needs repair work.
Suggested adding ADA compliance engineering for Turkey Hill into the planning funds.
A speaker recalled the 2018 study estimating cost to bring the primary school up to good condition and to replace its roof.
Municipal building borrowing must be considered alongside school borrowing capacity.

decisions.decision: Chair and Matt will draft the RFP language over the next couple of weeks and bring it to the next meeting.
Chris to talk with the town manager about procuring a computer for Matt.
Chris asked to identify which roof portions must be replaced in the next three years and send a marked-up space-use plan.
Committee agreed to coordinate a meeting with the school committee about phase three and Turkey Hill; the chair will contact Carol and Dr Burnham.

what_happened.line: The committee voted 5-0 to propose an update-only article for the November special town meeting.
Members reached general agreement on a phased plan: roof work and transition space at TCP first, then Ritter and a new town hall.
Phase three, tied to either TCP or Turkey Hill, was left unresolved; the committee agreed to seek a joint meeting with the school committee.
The chair and Matt will draft RFP language and bring it to the next meeting, and an ARPA request for a computer and architectural support was discussed.
The facilities director was asked to identify which roof sections must be replaced within three years and to send a marked-up space-use plan.

why_it_matters: The sequence chosen for Ritter, a new town hall and the TCP and Turkey Hill buildings will shape later borrowing requests, and the minutes say municipal building debt must be weighed against school borrowing capacity.
Residents may be asked at the November special town meeting to take up the committee's update article, and the phase three decision depends on talks with the school committee.
